<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#FFFFFF" />

  <!-- Header Title -->
  <text x="400" y="42" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1E293B">
    Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²
  </text>

  <!-- Definiton Subtitle -->
  <text x="400" y="68" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">
    In a right-angled triangle, the area of the square on the hypotenuse (c²) equals the sum of areas (a² + b²).
  </text>

  <!-- MAIN DIAGRAM GROUP -->
  <g transform="translate(0, 10)">

    <!-- SQUARE b² (Left, 4x4 = 16 units) -->
    <g id="square-b">
      <rect x="150" y="170" width="160" height="160" fill="#FEE2E2" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
      <!-- Grid 4x4 -->
      <path d="M 190 170 V 330 M 230 170 V 330 M 270 170 V 330 M 150 210 H 310 M 150 250 H 310 M 150 290 H 310" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" opacity="0.6" />
      <!-- Text label -->
      <rect x="185" y="232" width="90" height="36" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85" />
      <text x="230" y="255" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#B91C1C" text-anchor="middle">b² = 16</text>
      <!-- Pulse Animation -->
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;1;0.6;0.6;1" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.6;0.8;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </g>

    <!-- SQUARE a² (Bottom, 3x3 = 9 units) -->
    <g id="square-a">
      <rect x="310" y="330" width="120" height="120" fill="#DBEAFE" stroke="#3B82F6" stroke-width="2.5" />
      <!-- Grid 3x3 -->
      <path d="M 350 330 V 450 M 390 330 V 450 M 310 370 H 430 M 310 410 H 430" stroke="#3B82F6" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" opacity="0.6" />
      <!-- Text label -->
      <rect x="330" y="372" width="80" height="36" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85" />
      <text x="370" y="395" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1D4ED8" text-anchor="middle">a² = 9</text>
      <!-- Pulse Animation -->
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.6;0.6;0.6;1" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.6;0.8;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </g>

    <!-- SQUARE c² (On Hypotenuse, 5x5 = 25 units) -->
    <g id="square-c">
      <!-- Outer boundary polygon -->
      <polygon points="310,170 430,330 590,210 470,50" fill="#F3E8FF" stroke="#9333EA" stroke-width="2.5" />

      <!-- 16-tile region (Red overlay representing b²) -->
      <polygon points="310,170 430,330 590,210 470,50" fill="#FCA5A5" opacity="0.7">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.8;0.3;0.3;0.8" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.6;0.8;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </polygon>

      <!-- 9-tile region (Blue overlay representing a²) -->
      <polygon points="310,170 382,266 478,194 406,98" fill="#93C5FD" opacity="0.85">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.85;0.2;0.3;0.3;0.85" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.6;0.8;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </polygon>

      <!-- Grid 5x5 lines -->
      <!-- Parallel to BA -->
      <path d="M 342 146 L 462 306 M 374 122 L 494 282 M 406 98 L 526 258 M 438 74 L 558 234" stroke="#9333EA" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" opacity="0.6" />
      <!-- Perpendicular to BA -->
      <path d="M 334 202 L 494 82 M 358 234 L 518 114 M 382 266 L 542 146 M 406 298 L 566 178" stroke="#9333EA" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" opacity="0.6" />

      <!-- Text label for c² -->
      <g transform="translate(450, 190)">
        <rect x="-45" y="-18" width="90" height="36" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9" stroke="#9333EA" stroke-width="1.5" />
        <text x="0" y="6" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#6B21A8" text-anchor="middle">c² = 25</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- RIGHT-ANGLED TRIANGLE -->
    <polygon points="310,330 430,330 310,170" fill="#F1F5F9" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="3" />

    <!-- Right Angle Symbol -->
    <path d="M 310 315 H 325 V 330" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- SIDE LABELS -->
    <!-- Side a -->
    <text x="370" y="322" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E3A8A" text-anchor="middle">a = 3</text>

    <!-- Side b -->
    <text x="300" y="250" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#991B1B" text-anchor="end">b = 4</text>

    <!-- Side c (Hypotenuse) label along line -->
    <text x="380" y="240" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#581C87" transform="rotate(53, 375, 245)" text-anchor="middle">c = 5</text>

    <!-- HYPOTENUSE ANNOTATION / KEY TERM -->
    <g transform="translate(180, 100)">
      <rect x="-65" y="-14" width="130" height="28" rx="14" fill="#9333EA" />
      <text x="0" y="5" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">hypotenuse</text>
      <!-- Arrow pointing to hypotenuse -->
      <path d="M 50 10 L 135 90" stroke="#9333EA" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,3" fill="none" />
      <polygon points="138,93 128,88 133,81" fill="#9333EA" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- RIGHT PANEL: EQUATION & PROOF DISPLAY -->
  <g transform="translate(600, 95)">
    <!-- Card Container -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="170" height="355" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Card Header -->
    <path d="M 0 12 C 0 5.37 5.37 0 12 0 H 158 C 164.63 0 170 5.37 170 12 V 45 H 0 Z" fill="#0F172A" />
    <text x="85" y="28" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">Formula</text>

    <!-- KEY TERM EQUATION -->
    <rect x="12" y="60" width="146" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9333EA" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="85" y="90" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#6B21A8" text-anchor="middle">
      a² + b² = c²
    </text>

    <!-- Substitution Step by Step -->
    <text x="85" y="135" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Substitute sides:</text>

    <!-- Step 1: 3² + 4² = 5² -->
    <g transform="translate(15, 150)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="140" height="36" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1" />
      <text x="70" y="23" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">
        <tspan fill="#1D4ED8">3²</tspan>
        <tspan fill="#475569"> + </tspan>
        <tspan fill="#B91C1C">4²</tspan>
        <tspan fill="#475569"> = </tspan>
        <tspan fill="#6B21A8">5²</tspan>
      </text>
    </g>

    <!-- Step 2: 9 + 16 = 25 -->
    <g transform="translate(15, 198)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="140" height="36" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1" />
      <text x="70" y="23" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">
        <tspan fill="#1D4ED8">9</tspan>
        <tspan fill="#475569"> + </tspan>
        <tspan fill="#B91C1C">16</tspan>
        <tspan fill="#475569"> = </tspan>
        <tspan fill="#6B21A8">25</tspan>
      </text>
    </g>

    <!-- Step 3: 25 = 25 (Verified) -->
    <g transform="translate(15, 246)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="140" height="40" rx="6" fill="#DCFCE7" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="1.5" />
      <text x="70" y="25" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803D" text-anchor="middle">25 = 25 ✓</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Animated Status / Explanation -->
    <g transform="translate(15, 300)">
      <text x="70" y="15" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">Area Addition:</text>
      <text x="70" y="34" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">
        <animate attributeName="fill" values="#1D4ED8;#B91C1C;#6B21A8;#0F172A" keyTimes="0;0.33;0.66;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
        9 + 16 = 25
      </text>
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a circle</title>
  
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff" />
  
  <!-- Heading -->
  <text x="400" y="45" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="middle">Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- Circle Group shifted right for label space, moved slightly up to prevent overflow -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 240)">
    
    <!-- Circumference animation path/glow ring -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="942" stroke-dashoffset="942">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="942;0;942" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    
    <!-- Main Circle Fill and Stroke (Circumference) -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" fill="#edf2f7" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4" />
    
    <!-- Diameter Line -->
    <line x1="-150" y1="0" x2="150" y2="0" stroke="#2980b9" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,6" />
    
    <!-- Radius Line -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="150" y2="0" stroke="#27ae60" stroke-width="4" />
    
    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#2c3e50" />
    
    <!-- Pulsing effect on the Centre -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#e67e22" stroke-width="3">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="6;18;6" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Moving point along circumference to illustrate perimeter -->
    <circle r="7" fill="#e74c3c">
      <animateMotion path="M 150 0 A 150 150 0 1 1 149.9 -0.1 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Labels and pointers -->
  
  <!-- Centre Label -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 240)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-60" y2="-50" stroke="#7f8c8d" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="-60" cy="-50" r="3" fill="#7f8c8d" />
    <text x="-70" y="-60" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="end">centre</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Radius Label -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 240)">
    <line x1="75" y1="0" x2="75" y2="-90" stroke="#27ae60" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="75" y="-105" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#27ae60" text-anchor="middle">radius</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Diameter Label -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 240)">
    <text x="0" y="30" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2980b9" text-anchor="middle">diameter</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Circumference Label -->
  <g transform="translate(180, 140)">
    <path d="M 90 20 Q 20 20 5 -40" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="5" y="-55" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#e74c3c" text-anchor="middle">circumference</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Educational explanatory text box at bottom-left -->
  <rect x="40" y="370" width="340" height="90" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="210" y="398" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#34495e" text-anchor="middle">Key Facts:</text>
  <text x="55" y="423" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2c3e50">• diameter = 2 × radius</text>
  <text x="55" y="445" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2c3e50">• circumference = π × diameter</text>

</svg>

  <title>States of Matter</title>

  <!-- Title -->
